content: {"praised":["Beautiful story about reverse aging and life's moments.","Strong performances by Cate Blanchett and Brad Pitt.","Stunning cinematography and solid CGI visuals.","Emotional themes of love, loss, and memory.","Memorable music enhances the film's tone."],"criticized":["Depressing and mediocre acting from Brad Pitt.","Hammy scenes and horrible visual effects.","Story feels uninteresting and lacks depth.","Pacing feels slow and languishes.","Time concept confusing and fails to engage."]}
